editorial.blurb: Bird Bird Bakery and Cafe is a hidden gem showcasing phenomenal Asian-inspired pastries and breakfast items that deserve every bit of the buzz they're generating.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit early on weekends before noon to snag seating—they're only open Saturday and Sunday for 5 hours, so timing is everything to avoid the rush.
